# ReportAWM Plugin Report | Minecraft Bedrock Edition | API 1.0.14 | Nukkit | SupportAWM FOR SUPPORT/SUGGESTIONS/CUSTOM PLUGINS USE OUR DISCORD CHANNEL: https://discord.gg/mAZ9YMV3 ***Features:***
:star: Simple Report;
:star: Send information about report to VKONTAKTE or DISCORD;
:star: You can edit everything (messages, buttons, ..);
--- **Installation:**
:black_square_button: Place plugin's .jar file into `plugins` folder on your server;
:black_square_button: Configure in Config;
:black_square_button: Launch the server;
--- **Usage:**
:unlock: /report
